question: Two trains running in opposite directions with the same speed. If their lengths are 120 m and 140 m, and they cross each other in 10 s, find the speed of each train .
solution: Given: Length of trains are 120 m and 140 m and time taken to pass each other is 10 second. Calculations: Let their speeds be s. Total relative distance sum of lengths of both trains ⇒120 + 140
